title: Sticky element backgrounds must branch on visualDesignRefresh flag
answers: Why do sticky headers/footers look wrong under visual refresh?
What background color should sticky elements use?
How to fix sticky background color bugs in visual refresh theme
Sticky footer/header has wrong background when visualDesignRefresh is enabled
body: Sticky-positioned elements (headers, footers, modal headers) must use `theme.colors.background.page` when `theme.flags.visualDesignRefresh` is true, and fall back to the pre-refresh color (`background.canvas` or `background.primary`) otherwise. Pattern: `const visualRefreshEnabled = theme.flags.visualDesignRefresh;` at the top of `getStyles`, then `backgroundColor: visualRefreshEnabled ? theme.colors.background.page : theme.colors.background.<original>`. Applied in PublicDashboardScenePage.tsx:getStyles, DashboardBrandingFooter.tsx:getStyles, TemplateDashboardModal.tsx:getStyles. If a new sticky element is added without this branch, it will show the wrong (non-refreshed) background color once visualDesignRefresh ships.
applies: Any `position: 'sticky'` element's getStyles function in the Grafana frontend theming system
